title: ID0379634-DC/Si-D/IT[170002641] - Outlets out of order
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
Plugs not available when SCB is offline
Root cause:
Mix of Router 1 offline and coap polling error.
Workaround:
Hard restart the charger
Solution:
Unclear if Router 1 had issues. For EcoG coap polling error, v5.0.21 will be fixed

additional_info.subject: ID0379634-DC/Si-D/IT[170002641] - Outlets out of order CRM:00315001783
additional_info.body:
Ciao Luca, good morning. How are you?
From the logs I saw, there is nothing pertaining to this date because the Router 1 lost power or Ethernet connection to the switch.
Since we didn't have connection to AWS, the logs didn't come as expected, it's not fully detailed as if online.
What I can see is that during the time you provided there were 2 problems, Router 1 didn't have connection and EcoG (main) also lost connection to the charger.
I cannot see the error flag but according to this information the charger goes to failsafemode making it impossible to charge.
If you didn't perform a reboot during this time, then it could be that one or more fuses/breaker tripped and when it recovered the SCB connection and EcoG communication was lost.
I can only speculate at this moment since the logs have little information.
I hope I could answer the  best to your needs. From our side there is nothing else I can provide.
I will wait for your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0379634-DC/Si-D/IT[170002641] - Outlets out of order CRM:00315001783
additional_info.body:
Ciao Luca! Good morning. How are you doing? :)
For the EcoG problems, they are gone for now. Also, in this next week, on Wednesday it's supposed to be released the v5.0.21 that has the fix for the EcoG issues that I saw. So for now, you can tell the customer that
possibly
during this next week we will have a fix. But the problem that they reported is not about this one, so maybe you choose if you want to tell him or not, just in case we create the wrong expectations.
I noticed there is an error related to the Payment Terminal. It's a Valina terminal and here is what you need to do for it to work again:
Need to be commissioned on site
Request a terminal-id from worldline directly (there is nothing we can do)
I believe the CCV should already be comissioned from factory and only missing the terminal-id.
I will proceed to close the ticket since everything has been provided to you.
If you still need assistance regarding the CCV please open a new ticket.
Best regards,
Francisco
